Two blind non-author lanes with different briefs, one verdict per W9 record with the bytes read, as gate.rereview_of_fixup8 states. Each lane says cured or not cured for W3-010 strongest_rejected_alternative and W4-008 device_notes, and checks in every changed sentence that a listing stands under EXTRACTED and a weighing under INFERRED.

gate.rereview_of_fixup8: Records: every change record of the W9 log: eight for the eight exact spans of this file and at least one for each of the eighteen content-order fields; N is the count the log holds. Lanes: two blind non-author lanes with different briefs (the OW-19 floor), neither the W9 author, with the installed and applied rows, the OSHB and WEB witnesses, the mark layer, the device inventory, the language-zone layer and the crosswalk pinned to both. Each packet holds exactly N items, one per record, each with a verdict of support or challenge, a grade for a challenge (low, medium or high) and the bytes read; for an exact span the lane checks the applied text is the ordered after text; for a content order the lane checks the new text against the bytes this file cites and against the order. Each lane also states, for the records on W3-010 strongest_rejected_alternative and W4-008 device_notes, cured or not cured. Closed and peers met when: both packets hold N items; the count of challenge items graded medium or high across both packets is 0; the count of items in either packet that ask for a row change is 0; both lanes say cured for both named records; and B1 to B12 and B14 to B16 pass by script on the FIXUP-8 applied file. Then the orchestrator records the peers as met and the boss audit may launch without another controlling ruling. Any other outcome returns to the controlling agent.
